about: S101 renderer names (docs\renderer\NAMES.md 'Surface roles'): the functions that create render targets (callers of the surface creator 0x82CA88E0), each with the role of what it makes and whether that follows the render scale. Our annotations only. Source: docs\systems\render_targets.md (lodged from docs\research\s101\A0-2.md / A0-2b.md, 2026-11-11). scales = a screen image (follows the render scale); 'screen_shaped' = the class makes surfaces of several sizes (luminance, reductions) and which create is which needs a logged run (render_targets.md Unknown), so within this declared role only its screen-shaped surfaces scale; lasting = read in a later frame (never dropped by a skipped frame). [L] until a logged run confirms each creator's surfaces. tools\names\gen_origin_table.py writes src\renderer_adapter\surface_role_table.h.
